create_mobilenetv3_tv_trunk: create a MobileNetV3 trunk using the Torchvision implementation with configurable pretrained weights
create_mobilenetv3_timm_trunk: create a MobileNetV3 trunk using the TIMM implementation with trunk-only mode and intermediate feature extraction
download_mobilenetv3_torchvision_weights: download Torchvision MobileNetV3 weights and convert them to VISSL checkpoint format
download_mobilenetv3_timm_weights: download TIMM MobileNetV3 weights and convert them to Torchvision or TIMM VISSL checkpoint format
convert_timm_to_torchvision_weights: convert TIMM MobileNetV3 state dict keys to Torchvision naming convention using the built-in key mapping
